question: Where is the central AGMARK laboratory located in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **Nagpur**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Central AGMARK Laboratory** is located in **Nagpur**, India.
 
• It is responsible for **quality control** and **certification** of agricultural products under the **AGMARK** standards.
 
• AGMARK is a **certification mark** employed on agricultural products in India, assuring that they conform to a set of standards approved by the **Directorate of Marketing and Inspection** (DMI).
 
• The laboratory plays a crucial role in **ensuring the quality** and **safety** of agricultural products in the market.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**AGMARK** is a certification mark used on agricultural products in India, ensuring their quality and standardization. The term **AGMARK** is derived from **'Ag' for agriculture** and **'mark' for certification**.

The AGMARK standards cover a wide range of products including **cereals, pulses, vegetable oils, fruits, and vegetables**. These standards are framed and regulated by the **Directorate of Marketing and Inspection (DMI)**, an attached office of the **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare**.

The **Central AGMARK Laboratory** in **Nagpur** performs the analysis and testing of agricultural products to ensure they meet the required standards. This helps in maintaining the **quality** and **reliability** of agricultural commodities in the Indian market.

The AGMARK certification is crucial for **exporting agricultural products**, as it serves as a mark of quality assurance recognized internationally.
